test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Mukesh sold a car for ₹2,03,700 at 10% loss. For what price (in ₹) should he sell the car to gain 68% profit?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (at 10% loss) = ₹2,03,700

Loss percentage = 10%

Profit percentage desired = 68%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (C.P.) = Selling Price (S.P.) / (1 - Loss%)

New Selling Price (S.P.) = Cost Price (C.P.) ×
